title: Projecting Latent RL Actions: Towards Generalizable and Scalable Graph Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.19721v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph combinatorial optimization (GCO) has attracted growing interest, as many NP-hard problems naturally admit graph formulations, yet their combinatorial explosion renders exact methods computationally intractable. Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) combined with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have significantly improved learning-based GCO solvers. However, existing approaches face limitations in both generalization across diverse graph instances and computational scalability as action spaces grow. To address both challenges, we introduce \textit{projection agents}, a GCO methodology built on the Wolpertinger framework and adapted to a shared GNN-based latent space for observations and actions. These agents are trained to solve GCO problems by predicting a desired latent action in a single forward pass, which is subsequently decoded into a valid discrete action in the graph using the latent space. translated_title: 投影潜在强化学习动作：迈向可泛化且可扩展的图组合优化
translated_abstract: 图组合优化（GCO）引起了越来越多的关注，因为许多NP难问题天然可以用图的形式表述，但其组合爆炸使得精确求解方法在计算上难以处理。强化学习（RL）与图神经网络（GNN）相结合的最新进展显著提升了基于学习的GCO求解器的性能。然而，现有方法在两个方面存在局限：一是跨多样化图实例的泛化能力，二是随动作空间增长的计算可扩展性。为了同时应对这两个挑战，我们提出了*投影智能体*（projection agents），这是一种建立在Wolpertinger框架之上、并适配于共享的基于GNN的观测与动作潜在空间的GCO方法。这些智能体通过在单次前向传播中预测期望的潜在动作来学习求解GCO问题，随后利用该潜在空间将其解码为图中有效的离散动作。在各种基（准测试上……）
tldr: 提出基于Wolpertinger框架的“投影智能体”方法，通过在共享的GNN潜在空间中单次前向传播预测潜在动作并解码为有效离散动作，同时提升了图组合优化求解器跨实例的泛化能力与面对大规模动作空间的计算可扩展性。
en_tdlr: Introduces "projection agents" built on the Wolpertinger framework, which predict desired latent actions in a single forward pass within a shared GNN-based latent space and decode them into valid discrete actions, achieving both generalization across diverse graph instances and computational scalability for graph combinatorial optimization.
